scripts.watch: npx shadow-cljs watch app browser-test karma-test
scripts.build-report: npx shadow-cljs run shadow.cljs.build-report app target/build-report.html
scripts.ci: npx shadow-cljs compile karma-test && npx karma start --single-run --reporters junit,dots
scripts.vendor:weather-icons: mkdir -p resources/public/vendor/weather-icons/css resources/public/vendor/weather-icons/font && curl -s https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/weather-icons/2.0.12/css/weather-icons.min.css -o resources/public/vendor/weather-icons/css/weather-icons.min.css && curl -s https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/weather-icons/2.0.12/font/weathericons-regular-webfont.woff2 -o resources/public/vendor/weather-icons/font/weathericons-regular-webfont.woff2 && curl -s https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/weather-icons/2.0.12/font/weathericons-regular-webfont.woff -o resources/public/vendor/weather-icons/font/weathericons-regular-webfont.woff && curl -s https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/weather-icons/2.0.12/font/weathericons-regular-webfont.ttf -o resources/public/vendor/weather-icons/font/weathericons-regular-webfont.ttf
